closure_policy: A field-intake control is a pre-collection safety gate, not fieldwork and not proof. It cannot close affected-person, source-preservation, stewardship, or material-outcome gaps. It blocks fieldwork until owner-approved legal/ethics/privacy authority and data-linkage safeguards exist outside the cube.
control_role: Pre-collection controls that must pass before UI claimant or housing household outcome-tail fieldwork can start. These controls convert sampling gates into lawful-basis, consent/waiver, privacy, linkage, adverse-action, and publication safeguards without collecting private data in the cube.

adverse_action_firewall: participation refusal cannot affect representation, shelter, rental assistance, court support, or service access
field researcher cannot be landlord, opposing counsel, eligibility worker, or adjudicator
safety plan exists for retaliation, lockout, domestic violence, or immigration-risk disclosures
FIC-HC-001.closure_blocker: This housing control blocks fieldwork and gap closure until legal/ethics/privacy authority, partner-held key custody, consent/waiver posture, adverse-action firewall, safety plan, and publication controls exist outside the cube. Passing the control would still be design readiness, not household outcome proof.
consent_notice_floor: voluntary participation with no effect on services, representation, rental assistance, shelter, or court posture
contacts for questions, rights, complaints, and service referrals
future-use statement for de-identified or non-used data
withdrawal path that does not disrupt services or representation
FIC-HC-001.control_label: Housing household field-intake and displacement-linkage firewall
data_linkage_controls: separate contact roster from court/provider/shelter/rental-assistance extracts
minimum necessary fields for possession, displacement, debt, re-housing, screening, and durable stability
retention and destruction schedule outside cube
FIC-HC-001.human_subjects_boundary: Treat household interviews, hotline/community referrals, shelter or re-housing follow-up, court/provider record linkage, screening-aftereffect follow-up, and any identifiable or linkable housing records as requiring owner-approved human-subjects/legal/ethics screening before use.
lawful_basis_floor: documented human-subjects determination or non-research/service-improvement determination
documented consent, waiver, exemption, or lawful-basis route
public-benefit/service-program research route not self-certified by archive maintainer
FIC-HC-001.next_action: Draft an owner-approved housing field-intake protocol, safety plan, and data-linkage firewall memo before any household contact or partner record linkage.
publication_controls: cell suppression for small or reidentifiable cohorts
no narrative detail that exposes household, shelter, provider, or location
separate aggregate summary from partner-held records
owner-approved release review before any field-tail result appears in generated surfaces
recruitment_controls: do not recruit through landlord or adverse party
separate research invitation from legal representation and service eligibility decisions
community/hotline/shelter route for informal exits and lockouts
language, disability, trauma, and safety check before contact
compensation or burden offset reviewed for undue influence
stop_rules: participant reports retaliation, lockout, safety, or representation risk
linkage key or contact roster is requested for package storage
consent/lawful-basis path is missing or disputed

adverse_action_firewall: participation refusal cannot reduce benefits, delay claim handling, trigger fraud review, affect waiver or appeal, or alter debt collection posture
field researcher cannot be the adjudicator or debt collector
complaint/escalation route exists if participant reports retaliation or benefit interference

FIC-UI-001.control_label: Unemployment insurance claimant field-intake and linkage firewall

minimum necessary fields for payment, hold, debt, waiver, appeal, and hardship tail

FIC-UI-001.human_subjects_boundary: Treat direct claimant contact, observation, interviews, surveys, follow-up calls, and any identifiable or linkable private claimant records as requiring owner-approved human-subjects/legal/ethics screening before use.
lawful_basis_floor: documented human-subjects determination or non-research/service-improvement determination
documented consent, waiver, exemption, or lawful-basis route

public-benefit/service-program research route not self-certified by archive maintainer
FIC-UI-001.next_action: Draft an owner-approved UI field-intake protocol and data-linkage firewall memo before any claimant contact or partner record linkage.

privacy_posture: The cube may store control status, source receipts, cohort mappings, aggregate-safe protocol metadata, and redacted decision receipts. It must not store names, addresses, claim numbers, docket numbers, account identifiers, contact lists, raw recordings, private records, private screenshots, linkage keys, or partner-held reidentification keys.
